title: Jeush
summary: Assembler. (1.) The oldest of Esau's three sons by Aholibamah (Gen. 36:5, 14, 18).

inlines.v: Assembler. (1.) The oldest of Esau's three sons by Aholibamah (Gen. 36:5, 14, 18).
(2.) A son of Bilhan, grandson of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:10).
(3.) A Levite, one of the sons of Shimei (1 Chr. 23:10, 11).
(4.) One of the three sons of Rehoboam (2 Chr. 11:19).
